```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{CountingSort}{$A[1..n],k$}\State initialize $C[0..k]\gets0$\For{$j\gets1$ to $n$}\State $C[key(A[j])]\gets C[key(A[j])]+1$\EndFor\For{$i\gets1$ to $k$}\State $C[i]\gets C[i]+C[i-1]$\EndFor\For{$j\gets n$ downto $1$}\State $B[C[key(A[j])]]\gets A[j]$\State $C[key(A[j])]\gets C[key(A[j])]-1$\EndFor\State \Return $B$\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
